locale/data#

The locale data shipped with std: its versions, and the fallback chain of a locale.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

LocaleDataVersion().cldr();                         // "46.1.0"
let chain = LocaleFallbacks(Locale("de-CH"));
chain.item(0).string();                             // de-CH, then de, then root

Description#

The locale data shipped with std: its versions, and the fallback chain of a locale.
